The refusal is asserted today in two places:

No test drives the generic `/data` door over HTTP and asserts the 409 envelope (ADR-0112) end to end.

## Ask

Add one end-to-end test that drives the `/data` door with a create, and one with a rename, onto a declared name. Each asserts `status` and `code`. Test-only, no behaviour change. The lane is plugin-sharing or runtime.
